messages:
Jared: quick follow-up from today's all-hands finance segment \u2014 post runway/procurement questions here and we'll answer live.
Maya: Headline: cash runway ~18 months on base plan; downside scenarios + controls in the deck.
Noah: can we get a one-line breakdown of monthly burn? payroll vs infra vs GTM?
Maya: Monthly ~ $3.2M: payroll ~$1.4M, infra/GPU ~$1.25M, sales/marketing ~$350k, other ~$200k (rounded).
Sana: If bookings miss by 20% what tools do we pull first?
Jared: We aim for surgical measures: selective hiring pause (noncritical roles), pause major brand campaigns, renegotiate large vendor contracts, tighten procurement. Board notified if runway <12 months.
Noah: hiring pause details? who approves exceptions?
Maya: Selective only. Exceptions require VP + Finance approval; critical infra/customer-facing hires continue with documented justification.
Sana: procurement thresholds changed? renewals surprised us before.
ProcurementBot: New rules effective today: purchases > $5k require Finance review; > $30k require Legal + CFO signoff. Auto-hold on renewals > $15k pending review. Submit requests via https://redwood.internal/procure and tag "expedite_customer" for urgent customer-impacting buys.
Noah: SLA for approvals? last time it took ages.
FinanceBot: Updated SLA targets: <$5k: 2 business days; $5k$30k: 5 business days; >$30k: 10 business days. Expedited triage for properly tagged customer-impacting tickets (target ~24hrs).
Sana: Managers need small tooling budgets to avoid blocking sprints.
Maya: Managers can approve up to $1k; Directors + Finance for $1k$5k. Anything above requires Finance signoff.
Noah: what about buying GPUs (capex) to reduce opex?
Jared: We'll evaluate selective on-prem capex for stable Dedicated pools. Any capex > $200k goes through ROI review + board notification.
Sana: exception process for urgent >$30k purchases?
Maya: Open a procurement ticket, tag @Jared and @Maya, include customer-impact justification and rollback plan. We'll triage within 24hrs for real customer-impacting cases.
Noah: will any of this be shared externally? customers asking about stability.
Jared: No external comms planned \u2014 this is internal guidance only.
Maya: we'll post an updated approval matrix, a short procurement playbook, and an FAQ to #finance-docs. DM Finance for one-offs.
ProcurementBot: FYI: vendors with auto-renew > $10k have been flagged for review; check your team's flags under the portal.
Sana: thanks, closing thread.
